root_cause: Developer test script looping over unindexed S3 partition in infinite retry
remediation_action: Job terminated manually; S3 partition index fixed; retry limit enforced

root_cause: Data scientist launched p3.8xlarge for exploratory credit scoring model and forgot to stop
remediation_action: Instance terminated; auto-stop policy created; GPU launches restricted via IAM

root_cause: Microservice release v2.4 changed S3 client SDK configuration, dropping VPC Gateway Endpoint route
remediation_action: Hotfix deployed restoring VPC endpoint; integration tests added for routing tables

root_cause: Pre-launch stress test cluster (20x c5.4xlarge) left running over 4-day long holiday weekend
remediation_action: Instances terminated; TTL tags mandated on all perf test infrastructure

root_cause: Kafka partition rebalancing caused consumer group to fetch across AZ-1a and AZ-1c continuously
remediation_action: Kafka rack-awareness enabled so consumers fetch from leader in same AZ

root_cause: Payment service accidentally set to DEBUG log level before marketing campaign push
remediation_action: Log level restored to INFO; CloudWatch log ingestion anomaly alarm configured

root_cause: Custom backup Lambda script threw exception before calling delete_snapshot on older items
remediation_action: Replaced custom Lambda with native AWS Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) policies

root_cause: Disbursement reconciler synced entire transaction history instead of delta across region
remediation_action: Delta-only sync logic verified and deployed with idempotency keys

root_cause: DevOps test pipeline created test volumes during load run without delete_on_termination flag
remediation_action: Cleaned unattached volumes; enforced Terraform security guardrails

root_cause: Session store TTL bug in staging caused memory exhaustion and auto-scaling to larger node
remediation_action: Fixed Redis eviction policy to volatile-lru; rightsized cluster back to cache.t3.medium
